name: Starstruck

features.name: Multiplying Wilds
features.description: x2, x3 or x5 stacked wilds that multiply together.

features.name: Hot Zone
features.description: A Starstruck symbol on reel 2 triggers the feature.

review:
A compact 3x3 classic with five-row stacked wilds carrying x2, x3 or x5 multipliers – the x5 ones only on the middle reel – and wilds in the same line multiply together.

Land the Starstruck symbol in the hot zone on reel 2 to trigger the feature. Medium volatility, 1,635x max and a 37% hit rate. Simple, with lots of wins.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
